   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%werewolf%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%werewolf%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%role detection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%role detection%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
